_comment: Players removed from the game: player id → why. Owner's rule (2026-11-12): a player who never played a regular-season or playoff NFL/NBA game is not in the game (Michael Sam is the owner's one exception). Applied by build-players AFTER tiers and decoys are set (applyExclusions in scripts/lib/players.mjs), so removing one never moves anyone else. Only players never drawn can be listed: the build refuses one in data/eligible-since.json, since removing him would re-roll days already played. See docs/DATA.md.
